scope: Acquisition of previous-year Telangana Police SI / Constable question papers and their answers.
expected_justification: Nine PDF files were supplied by the user under source_material/pyq_raw/ and enumerated and SHA-256 hashed on 2026-09-07. All nine are local coaching copies; no board or coaching host was reachable to verify or expand the set, so expected here is the counted in-hand set of nine files, not an estimate of the whole universe of relevant papers (which remains unenumerable from this environment).
blocked_reason: Network egress from this environment is restricted to an allowlist that does not include any paper-hosting host, and web search returned no content. The broader universe of Telangana Police SI previous-year papers beyond these nine supplied files cannot be enumerated or retrieved from here. Per D-0017 the refusal is recorded verbatim and not routed around.
notes: Nine local coaching-copy PDFs are now registered in config/pyq_documents.json and pyq/papers/. Two (2016 Preliminary, 2016 General Studies) have a usable text layer and were fully extracted (400 questions). The other seven are scanned image-only or watermark-only and are registered as retrieved but not extracted.

Status is partial because the in-hand set of nine is fully accounted (acquired, hashed, registered) but the full universe of relevant papers is unenumerable from this environment; no claim of complete coverage is made.
A coaching-site copy of a paper is a legitimate T2_HISTORICAL_PYQ source, but is recorded with source_type COACHING_COPY and is never relabelled as a board document.
A paper reconstructed from candidate recall must be labelled CANDIDATE_RECALL and cross-checked against at least one other source before any question is classified.
